# SimpleXmlChildValueContainsBareAmpersand

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="native" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs)

Identify SimpleXMLElement::addChild value with known ampersand not part of a valid entity/reference. Exclude named entities whose declarations may come from the document DTD, unknown values and name-only calls.

## Detection

- Report SimpleXMLElement::addChild value with known ampersand not part of a valid entity/reference. Exclude named entities whose declarations may come from the document DTD, unknown values and name-only calls.
- A run from `&` to the next `;` counts as a possible named entity only when the text between them is an XML Name: a letter, `_` or `:` first, then letters, digits, `-`, `.`, `_` or `:` (plus the non-ASCII name characters of XML 1.0). Any other run, such as `&r=2;`, `&1a;`, `&;` or one containing whitespace, cannot be declared by a DTD and is reported unless it is a valid character reference (`&#38;`, `&#x26;`).
- Resolve builtin functions, classes, constants and methods, including imports and supported named arguments. Follow only bounded local facts within one lexical scope. Receiver and argument provenance must establish the specific API contract; variable names and comments never prove intent.
- Report one finding per violating operation. A reachable path, unchanged value identity and applicable API behavior are required. Intervening mutation, unknown calls involving tracked values, escaped aliases or exhausted analysis budgets invalidate proof.

## Exceptions (no report)

- Exclude unresolved required symbols, user-defined lookalikes, incomplete syntax, unknown required values and unsupported versions.
- Both `@custos-ignore SimpleXmlChildValueContainsBareAmpersand` and `@noinspection SimpleXmlChildValueContainsBareAmpersand` suppress this native rule.

## Fix

None. A repair requires a semantic decision or application error-handling policy.

## PHP versions

Available in PHP 5.3–8.5 where the referenced API exists. Do not apply extension contracts when the resolved API is unavailable. Gate syntax and version-specific behavior to the configured target.

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SimpleXmlChildValueContainsBareAmpersand": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file):

```php
// @custos-ignore SimpleXmlChildValueContainsBareAmpersand
```
